text:
maya: hey everyone — foster update! Luna the bun chose my laptop as a sunbeam loaf spot during my demo 😂. dropping photos
maya: [photo IMG_20260323_1.jpg]
tom: omg Luna is immaculate. :heart_eyes:
sam: is that a real rabbit or a plushie?? :eyes:
eli: pro tip: buns + keyboards = accidental hotkey therapy. have you checked for chewed cables?
maya: checked, all safe. she prefers the trackpad area. also named my keyboard 'bunnymac' now.
tom: send a video pls
maya: upload: [video IMG_20260323_clip.mp4]
giphy: :rabbit: *soft loaf* (gif)
sam: @maya she's practicing for the office 'bring your pet to zoom' day :laughing:
maya: planning to bring her for a quick cameo next Friday if transit is bun-friendly.
eli: will bring carrot treats and a bun-proof badge. maybe a tiny sweater? :sweat_smile:
ops-bot: reminder: pets at office allowed Fri 11-2, please register in #people-ops if bringing animals.
maya: registered! thanks @ops-bot
tom: 10/10 would pet. also blessing the loaf. :pray:
maya: loaf blessings accepted :rabbit::sparkles:
